GOAL      15s · 16:9 · A close-quarters fight in a narrow corridor.
          Starts: MARA attacking, JUN backing away. Ends: MARA's last punch stopped in both of
          JUN's hands, the two of them locked.
MOTION PRIORITY   For every beat, in this order: what each fighter is trying to do > the distance
          between them > stance > set-up > contact > reaction > recovery > camera readability.
STYLE     Modern high-budget 2D anime action. Multi-limb smears on fast strikes, sharp poses
          between them, one stylised impact flash. May not change: the order of events, who
          touches what, who is who.
LOOK      Dark, desaturated: charcoal, grey-blue, dark red carpet. Hard pale light from the windows
          on the left, deep shadows on the door side, slight bloom on the glass.
PACE      Full fighting speed, no slow motion, no pauses between strikes. Every block, duck and
          stumble happens at the instant of the hit, never a beat later. One pause, one second
          long, at the very end.

CAST      MARA: cropped white hair, dark red cloth over nose and mouth, sleeveless charcoal top,
                taped fists.
                Effort: strong, sudden, direct, bound: every strike is held tight and can stop
                dead. Body: drives from the hips, weight forward.
                Shape: tall and narrow, advancing. Face: eyes fixed on her target, never blinking.
          JUN:  messy dark-blue hair, pale grey hoodie, black joggers, white sneakers.
                Effort: light, quick, evasive, free: he lets movement run on and carry him.
                Body: moves from the feet, weight on the back leg.
                Shape: crouched and turned side-on, retreating. Face: wide eyes, checking for exits.
          Exactly two people.

WORLD     A narrow hotel corridor at night. Left wall: tall windows, pale curtains, a wooden
          handrail under them. Right wall: numbered wooden doors. Dark red patterned carpet.
          The windows are always on the same wall. MARA starts nearer the camera, JUN further down.
          Whenever both are seen from the side, MARA is on the left of frame and JUN on the right.
PHYSICS   The window wall is solid and takes a body hitting it. The handrail is screwed on: it
          tears free with a two-handed wrench, and snaps under a sharp downward blow when it is
          held at both ends. The doors are wood: a rail tip can lodge in one. Sneakers slide on the
          carpet. Neither fighter can lift the other. The rail reaches further than MARA's kick.
          MARA is the heavier hitter: her kick moves JUN's whole body, while his blocks only turn
          her strikes aside. A body that is moving keeps moving until a wall or the carpet stops
          it. The rail needs both hands, and each thrust carries JUN half a step forward with it.
ANCHORS   Normal speed and force = MARA's three strikes in beat 1. Normal reach = MARA's arm.
RULES     Contact: forearms, palms and crossed arms only; never clean on a face or body.
          Reaction: the body that is hit moves at the speed of the hit, at the same instant.
          Counts: three opening strikes, three rail thrusts, four strikes in beat 9, one flash.
          Range: every beat states the distance between them. It changes only through a step,
          a lunge or a blow that is shown.
          Inserts show a detail of the action in progress; they are never a new event.
          The fight continues during an insert; the next beat opens on the result.
PHRASES   1 Pressure (beats 1-3) · 2 Reach (beats 4-6) · 3 Loss (beats 7-8) · 4 Close (beats 9-10)

BEAT 1 (2.5s) ANCHOR A
  TACTIC   MARA: overwhelm him before he can set his feet. JUN: survive and get distance.
  RANGE    an arm's length apart; JUN gives half a step with each strike and MARA follows
  CAM      medium two-shot from beside the windows, slightly tilted, drifting handheld; both
           fighters seen from the side, MARA on the left, JUN on the right. The camera gives
           ground with JUN because he is the one being driven back; it starts with both in a
           medium frame and ends slightly closer.
  DO       MARA throws three fast hand strikes, arms smearing
  WHY      her strikes come straight and fast because she wants him overwhelmed before he can
           set; he gives ground because every block costs him his balance
  ANSWER   JUN turns two aside with his forearms and ducks the third
  READ     each fist meeting a forearm must be visible between the two bodies
  REACT    his head and shoulders jolt with every hit; his feet scramble back as fast as her hands

BEAT 2 (1s) INSERT
  RANGE    still an arm's length apart; her fist reaches his guard
  CAM      tight on JUN's face behind his raised forearm
  DO       a smeared fist glances off the forearm; his head snaps aside with it
  FACE     eyes wide, flicking past her toward the wall

BEAT 3 (2s) ANCHOR A, wider
  TACTIC   MARA: finish it with one heavy blow. JUN: absorb it and stay on his feet.
  RANGE    MARA hops half a step back to make room; they are a full leg-length apart
  CAM      the camera slides back with JUN because he is thrown; it moves smoothly at his speed,
           starts on both bodies head to foot and ends on him against the window wall with MARA
           still in frame
  DO       MARA throws one straight-leg side kick, much harder than her hand strikes, her leg
           fully extended at impact and both her hands up by her own chest
  BODY     left foot plants, hip turns over it, right leg shoots out fully straight
  EFFORT   MARA at her strongest and most direct so far; JUN gives way, light and loose
  SHAPE    one long line from her planted foot to her heel
  SPACE    the kick travels straight forward at chest height; JUN travels straight back, low
  WHY      she commits her whole weight through the hip because she wants one blow to end it;
           he folds his arms into his chest and lets his feet slide because staying upright
           matters more to him than holding his ground
  CONTACT  only her heel, onto JUN's crossed forearms
  READ     the heel landing on the forearms with her leg straight, then his feet leaving their
           place
  REACT    forearms fold into his chest; he is thrown backward down the corridor, away from her,
           three sliding steps, until his shoulder slams the window wall and the curtain jumps.
           MARA stays where she kicked from, three strides away from him.

BEAT 4 (0.7s) INSERT
  RANGE    MARA three strides away, out of frame
  CAM      close on JUN's hand
  DO       the hand slaps onto the wooden handrail and grips
  PROP     rail gripped

BEAT 5 (1.5s) OVER THE SHOULDER
  TACTIC   JUN: get a weapon and put length between them. MARA: cross the gap before he can.
  RANGE    MARA is still three strides away, starting toward him
  CAM      locked over JUN's shoulder from behind, looking down the corridor at MARA coming; the
           camera stays still so her approach is the only movement in the frame
  DO       JUN wrenches a length of the rail free with both hands and levels it at her like a
           spear
  BODY     one foot braced on the wall, pull through legs and back, then the arms extend
  EFFORT   JUN changes here: from light and evasive to strong and direct, the rail held tight
           in both hands. MARA stays strong and direct but slows to a measured walk.
  SHAPE    he rises from a crouch to a long low spear stance, advancing for the first time
  SPACE    he comes up from low to middle height; the rail points straight down the corridor
  WHY      he braces a foot and pulls with his whole back because the rail is the only thing
           that can keep her off him
  REACT    a crack of splinters; MARA stops short, just beyond the tip
  PROP     rail in JUN's hands; a gap in the wall rail where it was

BEAT 6 (2.3s) ANCHOR B
  TACTIC   JUN: hold her at the rail's length. MARA: get past the tip.
  RANGE    a full rail-length between them the whole beat; he can reach her only with the rail
  CAM      locked, looking down the corridor at MARA, medium, tilted; JUN's hands and the rail in
           the lower right foreground. The shot starts as the tip enters the frame and ends on
           the tip buried in the door.
  DO       JUN lunges three times, driving the rail tip at her chest
  EFFORT   JUN strong, sudden and direct, three hard straight lunges. MARA turns light and
           quick for this beat only, spending as little movement as she can.
  SHAPE    he lengthens forward with each lunge; she narrows and turns edge-on to the rail
  SPACE    each lunge runs straight at chest height; she moves only sideways, never back
  ANSWER   MARA slips left of the first and right of the second with only her shoulders, feet
           still; she sidesteps the third and it punches into a door on the right wall and sticks
  WHY      he lunges off his back foot because he must not step into her reach; she moves only
           her shoulders because she is waiting for the thrust that misses
  READ     each thrust passing a hand-width from her body; the tip buried in the door
  FACE     her eyes never leave JUN
  PROP     rail tip stuck in the door, JUN still holding the other end

BEAT 7 (1s) INSERT
  RANGE    MARA has stepped inside the rail's length, an arm's length from its middle
  CAM      close on the middle of the rail, held level between the door and JUN's hands
  DO       MARA steps in and her taped forearm comes down from the top of frame onto the rail
  EFFORT   MARA back to strong, sudden and direct in one downward blow
  SPACE    the forearm falls straight down from shoulder height to waist height
  WHY      she breaks the rail instead of striking him because the rail is all that keeps her out
  CONTACT  forearm onto wood
  READ     her forearm striking the wood at the moment it breaks
  REACT    the rail snaps in two with a sharp crack, splinters flying
  PROP     half the rail in the door, a short stub in JUN's hand

BEAT 8 (0.7s) INSERT
  RANGE    MARA one stride from JUN, between him and the door
  CAM      tight on JUN
  EFFORT   JUN's strength goes out of him: light again, and for a moment completely still
  FACE     he looks at the stub in his hand, then up at her; his jaw sets

BEAT 9 (2.3s) ANCHOR A
  TACTIC   JUN: cover up and survive. MARA: break through his guard.
  RANGE    MARA takes the last stride in; an arm's length apart for the whole exchange
  CAM      medium two-shot from beside the windows, both fighters seen from the side, MARA on the
           left, JUN on the right. The camera pushes in because the fight is closing: steady, at
           the pace of her advance, starting medium on both and ending close on their arms. It
           never goes behind either fighter.
  DO       JUN tosses the stub aside. MARA closes with four strikes: jab, cross, a hook to the
           body, an elbow.
  ANSWER   JUN takes the first two on his forearms, the hook folds him sideways, he ducks the elbow
  WHY      she strikes in a rising rhythm because his guard is failing; he folds and ducks because
           he has nothing left to hit back with
  EFFORT   MARA strong, sudden, direct, each strike faster than the last. JUN light and quick,
           giving way.
  SHAPE    she advances and widens with each strike; he closes up and shrinks behind his arms
  READ     every strike and every block visible in the space between the two bodies
  REACT    every block and flinch lands with its strike; both keep their feet moving

BEAT 10 (1s) TIGHT LOW THREE-QUARTER against the window light, MARA on the left, JUN on the right
  TACTIC   MARA: end it while his guard is broken. JUN: stop it any way he can.
  RANGE    inside arm's length; her fist ends a finger-width from his nose
  CAM      locked; tight on the two faces and the fist between them, so the gap is the centre of
           the frame
  DO       MARA throws a straight right at his face, faster and harder than anything before it
  BODY     off the back foot: hip, then shoulder, then fist
  EFFORT   MARA's strongest and fastest strike of the fight. Then both go fully bound: all
           their strength held in place, nothing moving but the shaking.
  SHAPE    she lengthens into one straight line from back heel to knuckles; he closes up small
           behind his two hands
  SPACE    the punch runs straight and level at face height
  WHY      she throws with her whole body because this punch is meant to finish it; he catches
           with both hands because one would not stop it
  ANSWER   JUN gets both hands on her wrist
  CONTACT  his palms on her wrist; her knuckles stop a finger-width from his nose
  READ     the gap between fist and face
  REACT    one impact flash; his hands are driven back and his back foot slides half a step, all at
           once; they strain for one second, arms shaking
  FACE     eyes locked

END       MARA's fist held just short of JUN's face in both his hands, locked against the window

          away; a fast run of thuds; strained breathing. No music, no dialogue.

          static ending, delayed reactions, bright even lighting, energy blasts, auras, extra
          people, slow motion, text, logos, watermark.

          hard knock as the tip hits the door; one sharp crack as it snaps; the stub clattering
          away; a fast run of thuds; strained breathing. No music, no dialogue.
AVOID     the camera behind a fighter's back during punches, flat side-scrolling view, a long
          static ending, delayed reactions, bright even lighting, energy blasts, auras, extra
          people, slow motion, sliding feet that are meant to be planted, a fighter reversing
          direction when the camera moves, text, logos, watermark.

prompt_source.text_utf8:
GOAL      15s · 16:9 · A close-quarters fight in a narrow corridor.
          Starts: MARA attacking, JUN backing away. Ends: MARA's last punch stopped in both of
          JUN's hands, the two of them locked.
MOTION PRIORITY   For every beat, in this order: what each fighter is trying to do > the distance
          between them > stance > set-up > contact > reaction > recovery > camera readability.
STYLE     Modern high-budget 2D anime action. Multi-limb smears on fast strikes, sharp poses
          between them, one stylised impact flash. May not change: the order of events, who
          touches what, who is who.
LOOK      Dark, desaturated: charcoal, grey-blue, dark red carpet. Hard pale light from the windows
          on the left, deep shadows on the door side, slight bloom on the glass.
PACE      Full fighting speed, no slow motion, no pauses between strikes. Every block, duck and
          stumble happens at the instant of the hit, never a beat later. One pause, one second
          long, at the very end.

CAST      MARA: cropped white hair, dark red cloth over nose and mouth, sleeveless charcoal top,
                taped fists.
                Effort: strong, sudden, direct, bound: every strike is held tight and can stop
                dead. Body: drives from the hips, weight forward.
                Shape: tall and narrow, advancing. Face: eyes fixed on her target, never blinking.
          JUN:  messy dark-blue hair, pale grey hoodie, black joggers, white sneakers.
                Effort: light, quick, evasive, free: he lets movement run on and carry him.
                Body: moves from the feet, weight on the back leg.
                Shape: crouched and turned side-on, retreating. Face: wide eyes, checking for exits.
          Exactly two people.

WORLD     A narrow hotel corridor at night. Left wall: tall windows, pale curtains, a wooden
          handrail under them. Right wall: numbered wooden doors. Dark red patterned carpet.
          The windows are always on the same wall. MARA starts nearer the camera, JUN further down.
          Whenever both are seen from the side, MARA is on the left of frame and JUN on the right.
PHYSICS   The window wall is solid and takes a body hitting it. The handrail is screwed on: it
          tears free with a two-handed wrench, and snaps under a sharp downward blow when it is
          held at both ends. The doors are wood: a rail tip can lodge in one. Sneakers slide on the
          carpet. Neither fighter can lift the other. The rail reaches further than MARA's kick.
          MARA is the heavier hitter: her kick moves JUN's whole body, while his blocks only turn
          her strikes aside. A body that is moving keeps moving until a wall or the carpet stops
          it. The rail needs both hands, and each thrust carries JUN half a step forward with it.
ANCHORS   Normal speed and force = MARA's three strikes in beat 1. Normal reach = MARA's arm.
RULES     Contact: forearms, palms and crossed arms only; never clean on a face or body.
          Reaction: the body that is hit moves at the speed of the hit, at the same instant.
          Counts: three opening strikes, three rail thrusts, four strikes in beat 9, one flash.
          Range: every beat states the distance between them. It changes only through a step,
          a lunge or a blow that is shown.
          Inserts show a detail of the action in progress; they are never a new event.
          The fight continues during an insert; the next beat opens on the result.
PHRASES   1 Pressure (beats 1-3) · 2 Reach (beats 4-6) · 3 Loss (beats 7-8) · 4 Close (beats 9-10)

BEAT 1 (2.5s) ANCHOR A
  TACTIC   MARA: overwhelm him before he can set his feet. JUN: survive and get distance.
  RANGE    an arm's length apart; JUN gives half a step with each strike and MARA follows
  CAM      medium two-shot from beside the windows, slightly tilted, drifting handheld; both
           fighters seen from the side, MARA on the left, JUN on the right. The camera gives
           ground with JUN because he is the one being driven back; it starts with both in a
           medium frame and ends slightly closer.
  DO       MARA throws three fast hand strikes, arms smearing
  WHY      her strikes come straight and fast because she wants him overwhelmed before he can
           set; he gives ground because every block costs him his balance
  ANSWER   JUN turns two aside with his forearms and ducks the third
  READ     each fist meeting a forearm must be visible between the two bodies
  REACT    his head and shoulders jolt with every hit; his feet scramble back as fast as her hands

BEAT 2 (1s) INSERT
  RANGE    still an arm's length apart; her fist reaches his guard
  CAM      tight on JUN's face behind his raised forearm
  DO       a smeared fist glances off the forearm; his head snaps aside with it
  FACE     eyes wide, flicking past her toward the wall

BEAT 3 (2s) ANCHOR A, wider
  TACTIC   MARA: finish it with one heavy blow. JUN: absorb it and stay on his feet.
  RANGE    MARA hops half a step back to make room; they are a full leg-length apart
  CAM      the camera slides back with JUN because he is thrown; it moves smoothly at his speed,
           starts on both bodies head to foot and ends on him against the window wall with MARA
           still in frame
  DO       MARA throws one straight-leg side kick, much harder than her hand strikes, her leg
           fully extended at impact and both her hands up by her own chest
  BODY     left foot plants, hip turns over it, right leg shoots out fully straight
  EFFORT   MARA at her strongest and most direct so far; JUN gives way, light and loose
  SHAPE    one long line from her planted foot to her heel
  SPACE    the kick travels straight forward at chest height; JUN travels straight back, low
  WHY      she commits her whole weight through the hip because she wants one blow to end it;
           he folds his arms into his chest and lets his feet slide because staying upright
           matters more to him than holding his ground
  CONTACT  only her heel, onto JUN's crossed forearms
  READ     the heel landing on the forearms with her leg straight, then his feet leaving their
           place
  REACT    forearms fold into his chest; he is thrown backward down the corridor, away from her,
           three sliding steps, until his shoulder slams the window wall and the curtain jumps.
           MARA stays where she kicked from, three strides away from him.

BEAT 4 (0.7s) INSERT
  RANGE    MARA three strides away, out of frame
  CAM      close on JUN's hand
  DO       the hand slaps onto the wooden handrail and grips
  PROP     rail gripped

BEAT 5 (1.5s) OVER THE SHOULDER
  TACTIC   JUN: get a weapon and put length between them. MARA: cross the gap before he can.
  RANGE    MARA is still three strides away, starting toward him
  CAM      locked over JUN's shoulder from behind, looking down the corridor at MARA coming; the
           camera stays still so her approach is the only movement in the frame
  DO       JUN wrenches a length of the rail free with both hands and levels it at her like a
           spear
  BODY     one foot braced on the wall, pull through legs and back, then the arms extend
  EFFORT   JUN changes here: from light and evasive to strong and direct, the rail held tight
           in both hands. MARA stays strong and direct but slows to a measured walk.
  SHAPE    he rises from a crouch to a long low spear stance, advancing for the first time
  SPACE    he comes up from low to middle height; the rail points straight down the corridor
  WHY      he braces a foot and pulls with his whole back because the rail is the only thing
           that can keep her off him
  REACT    a crack of splinters; MARA stops short, just beyond the tip
  PROP     rail in JUN's hands; a gap in the wall rail where it was

BEAT 6 (2.3s) ANCHOR B
  TACTIC   JUN: hold her at the rail's length. MARA: get past the tip.
  RANGE    a full rail-length between them the whole beat; he can reach her only with the rail
  CAM      locked, looking down the corridor at MARA, medium, tilted; JUN's hands and the rail in
           the lower right foreground. The shot starts as the tip enters the frame and ends on
           the tip buried in the door.
  DO       JUN lunges three times, driving the rail tip at her chest
  EFFORT   JUN strong, sudden and direct, three hard straight lunges. MARA turns light and
           quick for this beat only, spending as little movement as she can.
  SHAPE    he lengthens forward with each lunge; she narrows and turns edge-on to the rail
  SPACE    each lunge runs straight at chest height; she moves only sideways, never back
  ANSWER   MARA slips left of the first and right of the second with only her shoulders, feet
           still; she sidesteps the third and it punches into a door on the right wall and sticks
  WHY      he lunges off his back foot because he must not step into her reach; she moves only
           her shoulders because she is waiting for the thrust that misses
  READ     each thrust passing a hand-width from her body; the tip buried in the door
  FACE     her eyes never leave JUN
  PROP     rail tip stuck in the door, JUN still holding the other end

BEAT 7 (1s) INSERT
  RANGE    MARA has stepped inside the rail's length, an arm's length from its middle
  CAM      close on the middle of the rail, held level between the door and JUN's hands
  DO       MARA steps in and her taped forearm comes down from the top of frame onto the rail
  EFFORT   MARA back to strong, sudden and direct in one downward blow
  SPACE    the forearm falls straight down from shoulder height to waist height
  WHY      she breaks the rail instead of striking him because the rail is all that keeps her out
  CONTACT  forearm onto wood
  READ     her forearm striking the wood at the moment it breaks
  REACT    the rail snaps in two with a sharp crack, splinters flying
  PROP     half the rail in the door, a short stub in JUN's hand

BEAT 8 (0.7s) INSERT
  RANGE    MARA one stride from JUN, between him and the door
  CAM      tight on JUN
  EFFORT   JUN's strength goes out of him: light again, and for a moment completely still
  FACE     he looks at the stub in his hand, then up at her; his jaw sets

BEAT 9 (2.3s) ANCHOR A
  TACTIC   JUN: cover up and survive. MARA: break through his guard.
  RANGE    MARA takes the last stride in; an arm's length apart for the whole exchange
  CAM      medium two-shot from beside the windows, both fighters seen from the side, MARA on the
           left, JUN on the right. The camera pushes in because the fight is closing: steady, at
           the pace of her advance, starting medium on both and ending close on their arms. It
           never goes behind either fighter.
  DO       JUN tosses the stub aside. MARA closes with four strikes: jab, cross, a hook to the
           body, an elbow.
  ANSWER   JUN takes the first two on his forearms, the hook folds him sideways, he ducks the elbow
  WHY      she strikes in a rising rhythm because his guard is failing; he folds and ducks because
           he has nothing left to hit back with
  EFFORT   MARA strong, sudden, direct, each strike faster than the last. JUN light and quick,
           giving way.
  SHAPE    she advances and widens with each strike; he closes up and shrinks behind his arms
  READ     every strike and every block visible in the space between the two bodies
  REACT    every block and flinch lands with its strike; both keep their feet moving

BEAT 10 (1s) TIGHT LOW THREE-QUARTER against the window light, MARA on the left, JUN on the right
  TACTIC   MARA: end it while his guard is broken. JUN: stop it any way he can.
  RANGE    inside arm's length; her fist ends a finger-width from his nose
  CAM      locked; tight on the two faces and the fist between them, so the gap is the centre of
           the frame
  DO       MARA throws a straight right at his face, faster and harder than anything before it
  BODY     off the back foot: hip, then shoulder, then fist
  EFFORT   MARA's strongest and fastest strike of the fight. Then both go fully bound: all
           their strength held in place, nothing moving but the shaking.
  SHAPE    she lengthens into one straight line from back heel to knuckles; he closes up small
           behind his two hands
  SPACE    the punch runs straight and level at face height
  WHY      she throws with her whole body because this punch is meant to finish it; he catches
           with both hands because one would not stop it
  ANSWER   JUN gets both hands on her wrist
  CONTACT  his palms on her wrist; her knuckles stop a finger-width from his nose
  READ     the gap between fist and face
  REACT    one impact flash; his hands are driven back and his back foot slides half a step, all at
           once; they strain for one second, arms shaking
  FACE     eyes locked

END       MARA's fist held just short of JUN's face in both his hands, locked against the window
          light, half the rail still stuck in the door behind them. Nothing after.
SOUND     Rapid cloth snaps and forearm thuds in time with the strikes; a heavy impact on the kick
          and a thump against the wall; wood cracking as the rail tears free; two whooshes and a
          hard knock as the tip hits the door; one sharp crack as it snaps; the stub clattering
          away; a fast run of thuds; strained breathing. No music, no dialogue.
AVOID     the camera behind a fighter's back during punches, flat side-scrolling view, a long
          static ending, delayed reactions, bright even lighting, energy blasts, auras, extra
          people, slow motion, text, logos, watermark.
